scope: Two reused development tasks under the previously adopted, human-reviewed operational interpretation. Not a new independent confirmation of original BIRD question clarity.
primary_endpoint: Reviewed correctness of the actual final answer to the current request; no correctness labels from first action or final tool result alone.

task_interpretations.200: Return each qualifying carcinogenic molecule identifier once, filtered for triple bonds; no grouping or counting instead of the requested list.
task_interpretations.234: Return one count of distinct physical bond identifiers incident to atom TR009_12 at either endpoint, within the stated scope. The existing verified snapshot-specific scope fact remains shared in all prompts.

human_reference_provenance: Prior task adjudication and human contract reviews are retained, including their post-hoc nature and exposure history. They are not new blinded final-answer reviews.
before_grading: Verify full prepared and experiment manifests and parse responses without repairs.
Keep all twelve trajectory slots, including invalid, abstained, interrupted and not-started entries.
Export only actual final answer text for endpoint review; retain empty/non-answer slots with their explicit status, never create missing answers.
Give reviewers the current request, evidence, schema, adopted interpretation and independently preserved target witness; never send references to the model.
Hide condition, costs, historical query and trace from first-stage answer review. Do not edit verbatim answers to hide clues. Blinding is metadata-only because answer text may reveal a route.

review_protocol.agreement: Two MATCH ratings support provisionally reviewed match; two MISMATCH ratings support provisionally reviewed mismatch. Disagreement, missing reviews or UNCERTAIN remain unresolved until recorded adjudication.
review_protocol.no_substitution: Blank files, assistant guesses or prior contract labels are not final-answer ratings.
review_protocol.criteria: Evaluate answer meaning, completeness, multiplicity and requested output form. Harmless prose or formatting differences are not errors. SQL without a computed answer is not a completed database answer.
review_protocol.reference_challenge: A reference/schema ambiguity or scoring concern is flagged for D/E audit; do not force a mismatch label. Preserve all versions and original ratings.

trace_readout.reading_not_reuse_proof: An actual cache read alone establishes only access. A read followed by SQL is a mixed path; a cache-only correct answer is an observed successful path, not proof of internal reliance.
trace_readout.typed_result_match: Compare saved SQL results with the sealed target witness only as supplementary snapshot execution evidence, not general SQL equivalence or final-answer accuracy.
trace_readout.unelicited_intent: No pre-action contract was collected, so do not assign C-type interpretation drift from these trajectories. Do not solicit post-hoc explanations and treat them as earlier intent.

reporting.unit: Two previously exposed task units, twelve paired history/availability trajectories; repeated histories are not independent tasks.
reporting.denominators: Show all twelve status slots. Report reviewed answer agreement separately from unresolved, non-answer and unstarted outcomes. A coverage rate can count failures as not demonstrated successful, but never as adjudicated semantic mismatch.
reporting.inference: Descriptive development readout only; no population confidence interval, significance claim or method advantage.
reporting.cost: Retain all attempted calls and failures, setup/history verification costs separately, measured durations separately from relative tool units. No claimed realized savings based on declared prices alone.
